phase: client: challenge-start routes finished owner to challenge-result
problem: The challenge entry page always navigated to challenge-play, even when the server returned an owned FINISHED record — sending a paid, finished owner back into the play/trial surface (and its paywall) instead of their result.

changes.ROUTING: pages/challenge-start/challenge-start.js — after startChallenge, when the authoritative response is completed===true or destination==='challenge_result', navigate straight to /pages/challenge-result/challenge-result?recordId=<SAME recordId>; otherwise challenge-play as before. Trial remains a legitimate challenge-play target only for genuinely non-entitled users.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/challenge-start-routing.test.js (NEW) — finished → challenge-result (same recordId, not play/paywall); destination-only → result; unfinished → challenge-play (same recordId); fresh trial → challenge-play; error → no navigation + toast. Registered in tests/rc8.9/run.js.

rollbackPlan: git revert <client-commit>. Pure client change; rebuild preview. No server/schema/env impact.
